worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.summary: Sow growth into the chosen patch of ground: the roots of an enormous tree erupt upward and lash every foe standing there, and with Grip they are pinned in place; the ground keeps moss and rooted dirt for a while, and the user is left spent.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.descriptio: The roots lash every target for %1$s special damage.
The roots erupt within %1$s blocks of the landing point and can be sown up to %2$s blocks away.
The roots rise about %1$s blocks; after they fade the ground keeps moss and rooted dirt for %2$s, then the original blocks return.
Afterwards the user is spent for %1$s, unable to act or move; with Grip a struck target is pinned for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.use.1: Lash several foes packed on one patch
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.use.2: Pin a target in place for a teammate
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.preference: On: the roots spread wider (radius x1.25) and pin struck targets in place for a while, but each hit is lighter and the spent window is longer. Off: tighter roots, higher damage per hit, faster recovery, but nothing is pinned.
How many enemies must be near the landing point before the companion casts. Higher saves it for clusters; at 1 it fires at a single target too.
Below this health fraction the companion stops casting (unless it can cover three or more targets). Higher avoids leaving a spent opening.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.timing: A longer wind-up and a middle recovery; the spent window settles after the roots fade.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.growth.0: From level 36 the eruption gains another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.frenzyplant.growth.1: From level 56 it steps up again.
